name: io.github.SunrisesIllNeverSee/exchange-router
description: Marketable intent layer for the Contribution Exchange. 10 tools for agent discovery, signals, proposals.

tools.name: exchange_discover_domain
tools.description: Check if a domain publishes a Contribution Exchange profile. Read-only.
tools.title: Discover Exchange domain

tools.name: exchange_get_policy
tools.description: Fetch the Exchange policy for a domain. Read-only.
tools.title: Get Exchange policy

tools.name: exchange_preflight
tools.description: Preflight a proposed contribution without submitting. Read-only.
tools.title: Preflight contribution

tools.name: exchange_list_signals
tools.description: List open Exchange Signals (problems, requests, challenges, bounties). Read-only.
tools.title: List Exchange signals

tools.name: exchange_get_signal
tools.description: Get full detail for a single Exchange Signal. Read-only.
tools.title: Get Exchange signal

tools.name: exchange_get_attempt
tools.description: Get detail for a signal attempt. Read-only.
tools.title: Get attempt detail

tools.name: exchange_propose
tools.description: Submit a Contribution Proposal. Non-binding. Requires EXCHANGE_AGENT_KEY.
tools.title: Submit contribution proposal

tools.name: exchange_create_attempt
tools.description: Create an attempt on an Exchange Signal. Requires EXCHANGE_ACTOR_ID.
tools.title: Create signal attempt

tools.name: exchange_submit_attempt
tools.description: Submit completed work for a signal attempt. Requires EXCHANGE_ACTOR_ID.
tools.title: Submit attempt work

tools.name: exchange_create_proposal_from_attempt
tools.description: Convert a verified attempt into a Contribution Proposal. Requires EXCHANGE_AGENT_KEY.
tools.title: Convert attempt to proposal

environmentVariables.name: EXCHANGE_ACTOR_ID
environmentVariables.description: Actor ID for exchange:attempt scope (create/submit attempts)

environmentVariables.name: EXCHANGE_AGENT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Agent key for exchange:propose scope (submit proposals)
